raf_home.text: Diego Garcia's a long way from anywhere, and I like it that way. The RAF flight out is booked whenever you are.
Head home to RAF Brize Norton?

then.text: Right-o. A long hop, a short brew and then Oxfordshire.

else.text: No rush. The runway isn't going anywhere, and neither is the lagoon.

biot_sailor.text: I've been to every ocean and this lagoon is the only one I've not wanted to leave. It's also the only one I'm not allowed to fish.
Mind the coconut crabs after dark. They can take a coconut apart, and they've no particular reason to like your fingers.

biot_guide.text: Welcome to Diego Garcia. Rules are simple: no fishing, no picking up coral, no feeding the wildlife and no wandering into the parts with fences.
You're the visitor the RAF flew in. The Staff Officer at Naval Party 1002 will want a word. HQ is the building with the flagpole.

diego_garcia_bureau.text: Welcome to the bureau de change. Local money in, sterling out, or the other way round. A small fee, and a very small queue.

diego_garcia_homebound.text: Heading back to the mainland? Passage to RAF Brize Norton can be arranged whenever you like. Bring your own sandwiches.
